protocol.preprocessing: full undirected ogbn-arxiv; StandardScaler fitted on official training nodes, shared saved tensors
adapters: shared CPU inputs, official splits, node budgets and output contract instead of repository loaders
author GECC and GCondBase definitions loaded verbatim against shared runtime dependencies
training-index alias supplied to both reducers
GraphSlim initialization harmonized to author uniform sampling
author dense diagnostic assignments retained; GraphSlim diagnostic assignments remain sparse and use graph node IDs
protocol.timing: wall time with CUDA synchronization around entire in-memory reduction, including preprocessing/transfers; excludes imports, data loading, graph serialization, and downstream evaluation
protocol.memory: fresh process; process RSS sampled every5ms; PyTorch peak GPU allocated/reserved reset after context warmup, before input transfers; excludes downstream evaluation
protocol.quality: one shared GCN fit per reduced graph, seed0, 300 epochs, hidden256, validation selection every10; outside timing/memory; descriptive quality shortfall retained
protocol.gecc: full transductive graph; depth2; hop weights [0.6,0.5,0.0]; hard clustering; one restart, max300, epsilon1e-8; balance_alpha1
protocol.initialization: Author uniform sampled centers on both sides; GraphSlim initializer replaced only in this measured adapter. Native package defaults are not benchmarked.
